title: Keep task-sync recorded task sizes and Git delta sizes in one byte domain when the checkout converts line endings
outcome: Keep task-sync recorded task sizes and Git delta sizes in one byte domain when the checkout converts line endings
acceptance: a complete enrolment from a CRLF checkout followed by an incremental import that deletes or edits tasks leaves the recorded task_bytes equal to what the complete reader measures (no phantom bytes at task_count 0), or refuses the CRLF checkout by name, with a regression test under core.autocrlf=true
